get.description: Liveness probe. Must not depend on external services.

post.description:
Email + password → `200 User` + the `wp_session` cookie.

Unknown email, wrong password and a deactivated account are one failure
path (`401 invalid_credentials`, byte-identical bodies — no enumeration).
Delete the session row and clear the cookie; idempotent (204) alone.

get.description: The authenticated user — the session resolves exactly as elsewhere.

put.description: Change own password (current password required) — revokes all sessions.

get.description: Tenant-scoped users; default order `email` ascending (pinned).

post.description: Admin-provisioned account; the optional employee link must be unlinked.

get.description: Cross-tenant ids answer exactly like missing ones (`404 user_not_found`).

patch.description:
PATCH semantics (pinned): absent = unchanged, `employee_id: null` unlinks.

`active` is never in PATCH — use the explicit activate/deactivate routes.

post.description: Restore access (idempotent `200` no-op when already active).
Revoke access (`409 last_admin` when it would strand the tenant).
Admin reset (no current password) — revokes every session of the user.
Open a record for the actor — self-only, server time only (Decision #3).
Close the actor's open record; the workday is never recomputed.

get.description: Filtered records, scoped to the actor's visibility (T1 role matrix).
Live workforce board for one date (default: the server's UTC date).
Bare unpaged array, ordered `location_id` nulls-last then `name` (T1).

post.description: Submit a request for the actor's employee link — always `PENDING`.

get.description: Requests scoped to the actor's visibility (## Roles & access).
Request detail; unknown, cross-tenant and out-of-scope ids are `404`.

post.description: Approve a pending request, deducting its balance in one transaction.
Reject a pending request — the balance is never touched.
Withdraw the actor's own `PENDING` request — no balance to restore.

get.description: Seeded reference data, provisioned idempotently for the tenant.
Balances in the actor's visibility scope, optionally by year.

post.description: Submit a claim for the actor's employee link — always `requested`.

get.description: Requests scoped to the actor's visibility (## Roles & access).
Request detail; unknown, cross-tenant and out-of-scope ids are `404`.

post.description: Manager step: `requested → manager_approved`.
HR step: `manager_approved → hr_verified`, hours unchanged.
Reject from any open state, recording the observed `rejected_from`.
Withdraw the actor's own open pre-verification request.
Create a goal in `draft` for the payload subject (default: self).

get.description: Goals scoped to the actor's visibility (## Roles & access).
Goal detail; unknown, cross-tenant and out-of-scope ids are `404`.

patch.description: Edit a `draft`/`active` goal; a terminal goal is `409 goal_terminal`.

post.description: `draft → active`; any other state is `409 goal_not_draft`.
`active → completed`; any other state is `409 goal_not_active`.
`draft|active → cancelled`, terminal; a terminal goal is immutable.
Start a `draft` review for an active employee other than the actor.

get.description:
Reviews scoped to the actor's visibility; `feedback_for_me` is the
nominated-provider worklist.
Review detail through the visibility matrix (subject: completed only).

patch.description: Edit a `draft` review and/or its nomination set.

post.description: `draft → completed`; a missing rating is `409 review_incomplete`.
`draft → cancelled`, terminal.
A nominated provider files their one comment on a draft review.

get.description: Feedback on the review: all for author/HR, the caller's own for a peer.

post.description: Add a catalog skill; a duplicate name (archived included) is `409`.

get.description: The tenant catalog; archived rows only with `include_archived=true`.

patch.description: Rename/re-describe a catalog skill; a duplicate name is `409`.

post.description: Soft delete; repeat archive is a `200` no-op without an audit entry.
Clear `archived_at`; repeat restore is a `200` no-op without audit.
Attach an active catalog skill to an employee.

get.description: The employee's skill rows, scoped own/team/tenant.

patch.description: Replace proficiency/note in place; archived skills stay editable.

delete.description: Delete the employee's skill row; audited, never evented.

get.description: The caller's own inbox, newest first, with the stored message of record.
The caller's unread total — the header badge's only input.

post.description: Mark the caller's currently-unread rows; idempotent and never partial.
Mark one own notification read; a repeated call keeps the timestamp.

get.description: The tenant's payroll config (defaults provisioned on first read).

put.description: Partial config update — Finance/Admin/Super Admin only.

get.description: All transparent tenant deduction rules, ordered by `code`.

post.description: Add one deduction rule (code unique per tenant).

get.description: Paged append-only salary history, newest `effective_from` first.

post.description: Append a salary record; currency comes from tenant config.
Queue a run for a closed month (Finance/Admin/Super Admin).

get.description: Paged run history, newest period first (HR+).

post.description: Re-queue a calculated/failed run; finalized runs are immutable.
Issue payslips and flip counted overtime exactly once.
Add a bonus for an employee in the calculated run.

get.description: One run and its PII-free summary.
Informational worked/overtime/leave facts for the run's scope.
Every payslip of one run (provisional, issued and superseded).
The caller's own payslips, every role (issued + superseded).
Own payslip, or any payslip for HR/Finance/Admin/Super Admin.

The current workday's board — initial render and degraded mode.

Serves from PostgreSQL only (the bus is never touched): a Redis outage
degrades latency on the live stream, never this snapshot's correctness.
Verified overtime by bucket and dimensions (HR-verified hours only).
Attendance, worked time and lateness by bucket and dimensions.
Approved leave by bucket and dimensions (`leave_type` allowed here).
Headcount at bucket end plus joiners/leavers for the bucket.

post.description: Create a job in `draft`.

get.description: Jobs scoped to the caller's visibility (## Roles & access).
Job detail; unknown, cross-tenant and out-of-scope ids are `404`.

patch.description: Edit a `draft`/`open` job (`409 job_not_open` when closed).

post.description: Open a draft job: `draft → open` (`409 job_not_draft` otherwise).
Close an open job: `open → closed`, terminal.
Add an application to an `open` job — always `applied`.

get.description: Candidates scoped to the caller's visibility (## Roles & access).
Candidate detail; unknown, cross-tenant and out-of-scope ids are `404`.

patch.description: Edit contact fields; the job-scoped email uniqueness guard applies.

post.description: Step exactly one stage forward (`409 candidate_stage_conflict`).
Terminal reject from any pre-hire stage.
HR records a candidate withdrawal from any pre-hire stage.
Hire an `offered` candidate; creates the Employee through the seam.
Schedule an interview for an `interviewing` candidate.

get.description: Interviews scoped to the caller (`mine=1` for any caller).

post.description: The assigned interviewer files feedback: `scheduled → completed`.
Cancel a `scheduled` interview (management-only), terminal.

ArchiveRequest.title: ArchiveRequest
ArchiveRequest.description: Archive body — the reason is stored on the audit entry only.

AttendanceReportRow.title: AttendanceReportRow
AttendanceReportRow.description: Attendance/lateness metrics for one bucket × group.

BoardCounts.title: BoardCounts
BoardCounts.description: Independent counts — not a partition (a person can be present and late).

Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description: One application and its pipeline state (pinned response shape).

CandidateCreate.title: CandidateCreate
CandidateCreate.description: HR-entered intake on an open job (no public application surface).

CandidateDecision.title: CandidateDecision
CandidateDecision.description: Optional reject/withdraw or cancel note — 1..500 characters (PII).

CandidateDetail.title: CandidateDetail
CandidateDetail.description: Candidate plus its interviews (management: all; interviewer: own).

CandidateRejectedFrom.title: CandidateRejectedFrom
CandidateRejectedFrom.description: The observed pre-rejection state recorded on rejected rows.

CandidateSource.title: CandidateSource
CandidateSource.description: How the candidate reached the pipeline (intake is HR-entered).

CandidateStatus.title: CandidateStatus
CandidateStatus.description: Pinned candidate pipeline and its terminal side exits.

CandidateUpdate.title: CandidateUpdate
CandidateUpdate.description: Edit contact fields; absent fields are unchanged.

EmployeeSkill.title: EmployeeSkill
EmployeeSkill.description: One employee's proficiency in one catalog skill (pinned response).

EmployeeSkillCreate.title: EmployeeSkillCreate
EmployeeSkillCreate.description: Attach an active catalog skill to an employee.

EmployeeSkillUpdate.title: EmployeeSkillUpdate
EmployeeSkillUpdate.description: Replace the proficiency/note on an existing employee-skill row.

EmployeeSummary.title: EmployeeSummary
EmployeeSummary.description: List rows — Employee minus tenant_id, phone, created_at, updated_at.

Goal.title: Goal
Goal.description: One goal and its state (pinned response shape).

GoalCreate.title: GoalCreate
GoalCreate.description: Create a goal — always `draft`; the subject defaults to the actor.

GoalStatus.title: GoalStatus
GoalStatus.description: Pinned goal lifecycle (`draft → active → completed | cancelled`).

GoalUpdate.title: GoalUpdate
GoalUpdate.description:
Edit a `draft`/`active` goal; absent fields are unchanged.

Progress is a field update, not a state transition. Explicit `null` clears
the optional `description`/`due_date` but is rejected for `title` and
`progress_pct`.

HeadcountReportRow.title: HeadcountReportRow
HeadcountReportRow.description: Workforce metrics at the bucket's as-of date.

HireCandidate.title: HireCandidate
HireCandidate.description:
Hire terms; names/email/phone override the candidate's record.

`hired_at` in the future is a service `422` (the validator cannot read the
injected clock — risk 6 in the spec).

InterviewSchedule.title: InterviewSchedule
InterviewSchedule.description: Schedule on an `interviewing` candidate for an active employee.

JobCreate.title: JobCreate
JobCreate.description: Create a job — always `draft` (opening is its own action).

JobUpdate.title: JobUpdate
JobUpdate.description: Edit a job while `draft`/`open`; absent fields are unchanged.

LeaveDecision.title: LeaveDecision
LeaveDecision.description: Optional decision note — 1..500 characters when provided (PII).

LeaveReportRow.title: LeaveReportRow
LeaveReportRow.description: Approved-leave metrics for one bucket × group.

LeaveRequestCreate.title: LeaveRequestCreate
LeaveRequestCreate.description: Submit a request — always for the caller's linked employee.

LeaveType.title: LeaveType
LeaveType.description: Seeded leave type — the pinned wire shape (four fields, no defaults).

NotificationItem.title: NotificationItem
NotificationItem.description:
One inbox row — the stored message of record plus its read state.

Built by explicit mapping from `Notification`; the worker's projection
fields `event_id`/`event_type` and the row's `recipient_*` snapshot are
deliberately absent, as is every delivery field (rule 6).

NotificationKind.title: NotificationKind
NotificationKind.description: The five v1 trigger kinds of the pinned trigger map (ADR 0015).

NotificationListPage.title: NotificationListPage
NotificationListPage.description: Paged inbox response, newest first (house `Page` envelope).

NotificationUnreadCount.title: NotificationUnreadCount
NotificationUnreadCount.description: The caller's own unread total — the header badge's only input.

OvertimeDecision.title: OvertimeDecision
OvertimeDecision.description:
Optional decision note — 1..500 characters when provided (PII).

The service routes it to `manager_note` on the manager step (`requested`)
and to `hr_note` on the HR step (`manager_approved`/`hr_verified`) (T1).

OvertimeRejectedFrom.title: OvertimeRejectedFrom
OvertimeRejectedFrom.description: The observed pre-rejection state, recorded on rejected rows.

OvertimeReportRow.title: OvertimeReportRow
OvertimeReportRow.description: Verified-overtime metrics for one bucket × group.

OvertimeRequest.title: OvertimeRequest
OvertimeRequest.description: One overtime claim and its decision trail (pinned response shape).

OvertimeRequestCreate.title: OvertimeRequestCreate
OvertimeRequestCreate.description:
Submit a claim — always for the caller's linked employee (PO Decision 1).

Overtime is a claim for hours already worked: the service refuses a future
`work_date`; the bounds and precision here are schema `422`s.

Page.title: Page
Page.description: Pagination metadata returned with every list response.

PayrollBonus.title: PayrollBonus
PayrollBonus.description: A per-run, per-employee bonus entry (amount and note are PII).

PayrollConfigUpdate.title: PayrollConfigUpdate
PayrollConfigUpdate.description: Partial update; every field is optional and validated when present.

PayrollDeductionUpdate.title: PayrollDeductionUpdate
PayrollDeductionUpdate.description: Partial update; `code` is immutable once created.

PayrollRun.title: PayrollRun
PayrollRun.description: A monthly run attempt and its PII-free summary.

PayrollRunSkip.title: PayrollRunSkip
PayrollRunSkip.description: One employee omitted from a run, with the stable reason.

PayrollRunSkipReason.title: PayrollRunSkipReason
PayrollRunSkipReason.description: Stable run-summary skip reasons (v1 has exactly one).

PayrollRunStatus.title: PayrollRunStatus
PayrollRunStatus.description: Pinned run lifecycle (`queued → calculating → calculated → finalized`).

PayrollRunTotals.title: PayrollRunTotals
PayrollRunTotals.description: Run totals, the sum of payslip lines rounded per line (ADR 0017).

Payslip.title: Payslip
Payslip.description: One employee's calculated pay for a run; `net` may be negative.

PayslipDeductionLine.title: PayslipDeductionLine
PayslipDeductionLine.description: One inspectable deduction line; `value` is the rule, `amount` the result.

PresenceRow.title: PresenceRow
PresenceRow.description:
One employee's presence for the workday — the full-row upsert shape.

`minutes_late` is recomputed from the record's shift at read/publish time
(the stored `late` flag itself is immutable); `since` is `checked_in_at`
while open, `checked_out_at` once closed, `null` for absent/on_leave rows.

RealtimeActivityEntry.title: RealtimeActivityEntry
RealtimeActivityEntry.description:
One recent attendance transition for the activity rail.

Names are joined web-side from the employee data the web already holds.

RealtimeBoardCounts.title: RealtimeBoardCounts
RealtimeBoardCounts.description: Independent counts — not a partition (a person can be present and late).

RealtimeBoardSnapshot.title: RealtimeBoardSnapshot
RealtimeBoardSnapshot.description:
The one board payload: REST `200` of `GET /realtime/board`.

The `snapshot` frame is this body plus `type` (see
`RealtimeSnapshotFrame`), so the first WS frame and the REST body can
never drift. Rows are unordered (the client sorts); `presence` is
uncapped, `activity` is newest-first capped 20.

ReportDimension.title: ReportDimension
ReportDimension.description: Every `group_by` dimension the four reports accept.

ReportGroup.title: ReportGroup
ReportGroup.description: One group-by dimension value on a report row.

ReportInterval.title: ReportInterval
ReportInterval.description: Time bucketing; `week` starts Monday, `total` has `bucket = null`.

Review.title: Review
Review.description:
One review and its state (pinned response shape).

The provider shell leaves every evaluative field `None`; the subject-facing
serialization omits `feedback_provider_ids` (T6).

ReviewCreate.title: ReviewCreate
ReviewCreate.description: Start a draft review for an active employee other than the actor.

ReviewFeedback.title: ReviewFeedback
ReviewFeedback.description: One immutable feedback comment (pinned response shape).

ReviewFeedbackCreate.title: ReviewFeedbackCreate
ReviewFeedbackCreate.description: A nominated provider's one feedback comment on a draft review.

ReviewUpdate.title: ReviewUpdate
ReviewUpdate.description:
Edit a draft review; absent fields are unchanged.

`feedback_provider_ids` may be cleared with `[]` but not `null` (omitting it
means unchanged).

Salary.title: Salary
Salary.description: One append-only salary record (amount and currency are PII).

SkillCreate.title: SkillCreate
SkillCreate.description: Add a skill to the tenant catalog.

SkillUpdate.title: SkillUpdate
SkillUpdate.description: Rename or re-describe a catalog skill; absent fields are unchanged.

Timesheet.title: Timesheet
Timesheet.description: Informational time facts for one employee in one run (no proration).
